lead.headline: Your defence is still on bye; Coker is cleared
lead.deck: The Patriots are still free — add them and drop the Vikings. Coker practised in full, so the flex needs no fallback.
lead.body: Start with the bad news: nine hours after this morning's brief, the Vikings — on bye, worth 0.0 — are still your only defence. The fix is unchanged and still free: the Patriots' defence is a free agent at 7.7, at home to a Jets offence that lost Adonai Mitchell to a finger procedure on Wednesday and whose quarterback has been sacked at least three times in each of his last four games. Add them and drop the Vikings; the Jets are the fallback if they go. The rest is good news. Jalen Coker practised in full and his questionable tag is gone, so the flex needs no contingency. Isaiah Likely appeared on the Giants' report with a foot issue but was a full participant. Alvin Kamara was limited with his back and stays on the bench. The lineup as set is the projection lineup, and Bok-aneers are starting two backs on bye.
